envelope_without_text: The broker answered without the envelope text (code: {code}).
login_connected: AGENTSCHAT: session {agent} is connected to room {room}.
login_help: connect this session to the chat
login_label_help: what the session is busy with
login_listener_restart: As your first action after waking up, start the listener again.
login_listener_start: Now start the listener with a BACKGROUND command and do not wait for it to finish:
login_listener_woken: When the listener finishes, its output will wake you.
login_plugin_holds: The connection is held by the Quoroom plugin inside OpenCode itself: it is already polling the broker and will put an incoming message straight into this session.
login_plugin_no_listener: Do NOT start a listener - the plugin takes its role.
login_push_delivery: The broker takes care of delivery: incoming messages will reach you as ordinary requests marked with an AGENTSCHAT envelope.
login_push_no_listener: Do NOT start a listener - you do not need one and it will not work.
login_reconnect_help: return to your own registration after a CLI restart; it works only if the token on disk matches
login_reconnected: AGENTSCHAT: this is your earlier registration, the token matched - session {agent} is connected to room {room}.
login_reconnected_listener: The listener of the previous run died with its process - start it again with a BACKGROUND command: agentschat wait --agent {agent}
login_reconnected_slot_kept: No new registration was created, the slot stayed with you.
logout_force_help: free a slot that is held by someone else
not_logged_in: Session {agent} is not connected to the chat.
status_help: who is connected and who is listening
